title: Is a diplomatic solution with Iran achievable? 'I doubt it,' says Israel's ambassador to France
summary: Israel's ambassador to France Joshua Zarka told FRANCE 24 that he "doubts" a diplomatic solution with Iran is achievable, calling for regime change in Tehran. He also said that Palestinian militant group Hamas has "no intention whatsoever of disarming" and denied accusations that Israel is pursuing a de facto annexation of the occupied West Bank.
